feeds.title: Nonfiction Authors Association Blog
feeds.description: Educational Resources and Book Marketing Support for Nonfiction Authors. The Nonfiction Authors Association is a marketing community for authors. We also host a year-round Nonfiction Book Awards program honoring self-published and traditionally published books throughout the year.

feeds.title: Write Nonfiction NOW Blog
feeds.description: This mission of this blog is to motivate nonfiction writers, entrepreneurs, and even non-writers to create publishable and published products. It also strives to provide you with the high performance strategies, tips and tools you need to achieve the success you desire, to develop a careers as an authors, and to build a businesses around your books and writing.

feeds.title: Hippocampus
feeds.description: Hippocampus Magazine is an online literary magazine featuring creative nonfiction: memoir, essays, interviews, reviews, articles; also seeking submissions. We're an online publication set out to entertain, educate and engage writers and readers of creative nonfiction. We also have a books division and bring our mission to life with an annual writing conference.

feeds.title: BREVITY's Nonfiction Blog
feeds.description: Brevity Blog is a place to discuss issues related to the writing of creative nonfiction. Brevity: A Journal of Concise Literary Nonfiction has published well-known and emerging writers working in the extremely brief essay form, along with craft essays and book reviews.

feeds.title: SMS Nonfiction Book Reviews
feeds.description: Nonfiction book reviews (children, teen and adult). Common nonfiction topics include: parenting, world religions, psychology, life, cooking, mental health, animals, culture and more. My mission is to help readers pick the book that would be good for them, especially nonfiction. Thorough nonfiction reviews including what you will find and who might benefit from it.

feeds.title: Become a Writer Today Blog
feeds.description: I'm a non-fiction author from Ireland who writes for publications like Forbes. If you want to become a better non-fiction writer or start earning more money, decide what type of writer you are.

feeds.title: A. M. Palmer, Literary Non-fiction
feeds.description: Dive into literary essays and ideas from author A. M. Palmer. He writes on a variety of topics, often common or abstract, and offers vivid, provoking commentary on little things throughout. Palmer is currently at work on another book project, continuing with graphic design endeavors, and developing new creative writing course materials.

feeds.title: Creative Nonfiction Collective Blog
feeds.description: The CNFC Society exists to promote innovation in Canadian creative nonfiction writing. We strive for greater readership, to provide opportunities for our members to enrich their professional skills, to collaborate on new technologies, and explore new approaches to publishing.

feeds.title: A Little Blog Of Books » Non fiction
feeds.description: Hello! My name is Clare, I live near London and I have been running this blog since March 2012. I like books and I read quite a lot of them - mostly contemporary, literary, and translated fiction and non-fiction covering history, politics and popular science amongst other things. In this blog, you can read my book reviews and other literacy-related musings.

feeds.title: Bookfever
feeds.description: I'm Stephanie, a 28-year-old book blogger, and reviewer who has a passion for all things bookish. My favorite genres are historical fiction, nonfiction, dark romance, fantasy, and science fiction but I give any genre a fair chance.

feeds.title: Louloureads » Non-Fiction
feeds.description: A blog by an enthusiast about almost everything, really, and books in particular. The author likes to read indiscriminately and happily and avidly. She often discusses recommendations with her friends and press favorite novels into their hands. This blog is, as much as anything, an attempt to spare them some of that by being bookish and nerdy with a group of people who share the excitement.

feeds.title: JourneySixty6 Blog
feeds.description: A Nonfiction Book Writing Blog covering articles about book publishing and promotion. Through this blog, Melissa Parks and Dave Goetz provide encouragement and practical help for writers. JourneySixty6 is a learning community of writers who aspire to change the world with their words.

feeds.title: Assay: A Journal of Nonfiction Studies
feeds.description: The purpose of Assay is to publish the best critical scholarship of nonfiction texts, facilitate all facets of nonfiction conversations in a variety of disciplines, and be a resource for writers, scholars, readers, and teachers of nonfiction.

feeds.title: Mississauga Library System Nonfiction Book Blog
feeds.description: Here we will post book reviews and book club discussion questions to encourage the discussion of nonfiction books and to support your local book clubs.

feeds.title: Reading For Sanity
feeds.description: Reading For Sanity covers book reviews and other book news. Read full and vividly descriptive book summaries, author's personal ideas, commentary, and more. Find the next book on your coffee table from these awesome recommendations!

feeds.title: Celebrate Science
feeds.description: Welcome teachers, librarians, homeschoolers and nonfiction writers! This blog offers innovative resources for teaching science and tips for writing nonfiction. Melissa Stewart writes science books for children and cares deeply about science and literacy education.

feeds.title: Maphead's Book Blog
feeds.description: Pillaging the public library so you don't have to. Books are life. My blog is almost exclusively devoted to non-fiction. My focus is mainly restricted to comparative religion, history, international relations/area studies, biographies, current affairs, narrative non-fiction and some memoirs. I also have a fond weakness for books from university presses.

feeds.title: HEPPAS Books
feeds.description: New books in History, Economics, Politics, Philosophy, Anthropology, and Sociology.

feeds.title: ShelleyWilsonAuthor » Non Fiction
feeds.description: I'm Shelley, an English author of motivational self-help titles and young adult fantasy fiction. My sensible side writes non-fiction books to inspire you to survive and thrive, and my playful side writes young adult fiction to remind you to nurture that inner teen. You'll find me sharing book reviews, author interviews, and chatting about writing on my author blog & talking about personal development on my motivational blog.

feeds.title: idealistatheart.com
feeds.description: I'm a thirty something woman living in Luxembourg, Europe who reads a lot and thinks too much. It is my firm belief that one book, one idea, one dream at a time can inspire all of us, so we can become more fulfilled individuals who form a more just, more equal and more sustainable society. Find nonfiction book recommendations and more.

feeds.title: She Seeks Nonfiction Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to my blog! I'm Rebekah, a lifelong student, curious atheist, and creative introvert. I love to read and write about social justice, atheism, religion, science (especially human evolution), and the ever-inspiring words of Carl Sagan. Join me as I use skepticism and critical thinking to seek out that which is nonfiction while exposing fiction and pseudoscience for what they are.

feeds.title: Youth Services Book Review Blog
feeds.description: Reviews of current nonfiction, fiction, and picture books by Massachusetts Librarians! We are dedicated to providing an alternate source of reviews for the librarians of Massachusetts (and the world). The group started as part of Youth Services provided by NMRLS by librarian Michael Williams around 2007.

feeds.title: Book Riot » Nonfiction
feeds.description: News on new nonfiction books and recs for the best nonfiction books, including historical books, biographies, nonfiction books for kids, and more, from Book Riot. Book Riot is the largest independent editorial book site in North America, and home to a host of media, from podcasts to newsletters to original content, all designed around diverse readers and across all genres.

feeds.title: Mal Warwick On Books » Nonfiction
feeds.description: Mal Warwick is an author, impact investor, and activist who reviews books on his blog. Three to five times per week, you'll find the most recent books reviewed on this site, which has been published since January 2010.

feeds.title: Doing Dewey
feeds.description: This blog is part of a project where I try to read one non-fiction book for every number in the Dewey Decimal system, but I have pretty eclectic tastes and review books from a wide variety of genres. I also host a weekly feature, Nonfiction Friday, where you can get the latest nonfiction news, share your posts about nonfiction books, and find other readers who love nonfiction

feeds.title: Nonfiction Monday
feeds.description: Rounding up the best nonfiction for children and teens. Bloggers across the kidlitosphere celebrate Nonfiction Monday by writing about nonfiction books for kids on Monday.

feeds.title: Jerry Jenkins » Nonfiction
feeds.description: Jerry Jenkins is the author of nearly 200 books with sales of more than 71 million copies, including the bestselling Left Behind series. This is a blog for passionate writers to learn & sharpen their skills about nonfiction writing.

feeds.title: Nonfictioness Blog
feeds.description: Since 2011 I have been busily working as a freelance writer and editor juggling writing books, project managing a vast array of Lego building operations and editing and indexing a number of non-fiction titles. This blog is about my thoughts and nonfiction books I read.

feeds.title: The Nonfiction Detectives
feeds.description: Two intrepid librarians, one works in a school library and the other in a public library, together explore nonfiction titles to find the best for the children they service.

feeds.title: InkAndThoughts » Non-Fiction
feeds.description: Hi, I am Bhagyashree! I like to bring together the little things that make me happy, together, which I believe will ultimately become a part of my long, long novel! I started this blog to give my love for reading and writing a platform and to meet like-minded individuals.

feeds.title: Non-Fiction Gyan
feeds.description: A blog for those with an insatiable curiosity for non-fiction books.

feeds.title: Everyday Reading
feeds.description: Everyday Reading gives parents easy, straight-forward strategies for creating a culture of reading in their home, plus recommendations for the best books for every age.

feeds.title: Sophisticated Dorkiness
feeds.description: A bookworm journalist blogs on literature and life. I tend to read memoirs, literary journalism, and literary fiction, but you'll see comics and young adult fiction thrown in for fun. I enjoy literary nonfiction (on almost any topic), essays, memoirs, 'straight' nonfiction (media studies, cultural studies, some science, feminism, politics, language, and journalism, mostly), and travel narratives.

feeds.title: Lola's Blog Tours
feeds.description: Hi! I am Lola, the owner of Lola's Blog Tours. Reading and everything surrounding books is my passion and I want to help spread the word about those amazing books out there. This is a blog about organizing book blog tours, cover reveals, book blitzes, and review opportunities.

feeds.title: Cameron's Non-Fiction Writing Blog
feeds.description: Non-Fiction Writing Blog by Cameron McGill. Subscribe to read the latest articles and updates.

feeds.title: Jashan Takhar Nonfiction Writing Blog
feeds.description: Non-Fiction Writing Blog by Jashan Takhar. Subscribe to read the latest articles and updates.

feeds.title: Arjun Nonfiction Writing Blog
feeds.description: Non-Fiction Writing Blog by Arjun. Subscribe to read the latest articles and updates.

feeds.title: Other Women's Stories
feeds.description: I read mostly nonfiction. I love memoirs, contemporary poetry, cookbooks, children's picture books, and the (very) occasional literary novel. But in the last year or so, I've been reading a lot more general nonfiction. Favorite topics include: world cultures (esp. Europe, the Middle East, and Asia), American history, politics and presidents, faith and religions, cooking and food, and parenting.

feeds.title: The Book Blog » Nonfiction
feeds.description: The Book Blog is all about the passion of a group of readers who are here to let the world know what they read. We are the readers who seem to have lost something in some pages of some book a hundred years ago and today, looking for that thing, we are turning the pages of any book which falls ahead of us and in doing so, we enjoy the contents of the book as well! Go through our nonfiction book listings, reviews and more!

feeds.title: Njkinny's Blog » Nonfiction
feeds.description: Njkinny is a hopeless book lover, binge reader, mom extraordinaire, passionate writer, 2019 NanoWrimo Winner and winner of several writing contests. Her sole aim in life is to bring the awesomeness of books in front of the world. Check out her nonfiction recommendations, reviews, features and more!

feeds.title: Nonfiction Book Accelerator Blog
feeds.description: Check out our articles that help you write, publish, and market your first nonfiction book. Sylvia Melena is the Founder and CEO of Melena Consulting Group, a leadership and management training, book coaching, and publishing company.

feeds.title: The OC BookGirl
feeds.description: The OCBookGirl is a book blog featuring new books and bookish events in Southern California. Explore non-fiction book reviews & features.

feeds.title: Asian Review of books » Non-fiction Review
feeds.description: The Asian Review of Books is the only dedicated pan-Asian book review publication. Widely quoted, referenced, and republished by leading publications in Asian and beyond and with an archive of more than two thousand book reviews, the ARB also features long-format essays by leading Asian writers and thinkers, excerpts from newly-published books and reviews of arts and culture. Explore some of the best non-fiction Asian books, authors, reviews and more!

feeds.title: Citizen Reader
feeds.description: A blog on all things nonfiction by Sarah Statz Cords (nonfiction reader, author, freelance librarian, indexer, and oftentimes crank).

feeds.title: NonFiction Ninjas | Ninja Notebook
feeds.description: The Nonfiction Ninjas are a group of nonfiction authors who first met at a retreat at the Writing Barn in Austin, TX. We became fast friends and realized we have a passion for nonfiction that we want to share with you. We started this website, and some of us put together the NF Fest challenge.

feeds.title: Shari Caudron Blog
feeds.description: A blog for nonfiction book authors. I'm Shari Caudron and I help authors understand, write, and publish nonfiction books they've always dreamed of writing. My goal is to teach you everything I've learned about the life-changing power of personal storytelling.
